newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobile phones in France up 4.8 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Mobile phones in France up 4.8 pct in February.

text.p: The number of mobile telephones subscriptions in France increased by 123,700 or 4.8 percent to 2.73 million in February compared with a year earlier, telecoms regulator ART said on Tuesday.
It said subscriptions rose 5.4 percent for digital phones to 2.53 million, but fell 3.4 percent to 197,200 for analog.

The Itineris service of France Telecom posted a 4.2 percent rise in February to 1.46 million subscribers; SFR, part of Generale des Eaux showed a 7.1 percent rise to 925,400 and Bouygues Telecom's business increased by 7.7 percent to 108,300 subscribers.
